description: Search the Vibesignet template library. Returns matching templates with their key, sector, look and a one-line description. No access key needed. Call with no arguments to list every template.

look.description: Limit to light, mid-tone or dark templates.

query.description: Words to match against the name, sector, product and description, for example "flight school" or "watch".

sector.description: Limit to one sector, for example "Hospitality".

name: search_templates
title: Search templates
